about: The four voice clips, transcribed once and replayed from cache. Every field here was produced by settle/api/voice.py:trace() — the same function POST /voice/extract runs — so the committed demo and the live endpoint cannot drift.
anchor_note: A declared constant, not today. Relative dates resolve against the case's created_at; a clock would make the replay irreproducible.

transcription.finding: With language='hi' and no prompt, gpt-4o-transcribe returned Urdu in Arabic script for all four clips, and truncated clip 1 before its self-correction. A romanised-Hinglish prompt fixes the script and recovers the clause. At the default temperature the same audio gave three different strings in four calls, one of them truncated; at 0 it is stable. Both are recorded in settle/text/voice.py.
